comment: still the same awful layout, the card style is dumb and i want my album tiles back. i already canceled premium over this and if they dont turn the music tab back im switching to apple music, thats it.
so i'm paying more and podcast ads still play for premium? cool. ad-free music is still the main reason i pay so i'll grumble and stay, but the podcast push on my home screen is the real problem.
been on premium for years and i cant imagine going back. a dollar more a month is nothing compared to what i get, the cancel flow is still the annoying part for me. staying.
price bump is fine by me as long as the features keep coming. radio and discover weekly are still better than anything else i've tried. would be nice to get album radio back though.

ANOTHER increase and the home screen is still a podcast billboard. show me the music first. im not cancelling yet because premium is still worth it for music and skipping ads while driving, but im getting real tired of this.

a dollar more for something still stuck at 320kbps with no lossless? tidal and apple music look like better value if you care about hi-fi. i'll stay for the convenience on airpods and in the car but this makes me question it.
a buck more and premium is still the best deal i pay for. free is basically unusable so i'm not going back. it'd take a lot more than this to make me cancel.

i'm on an old build anyway so this doesn't touch me unless they force an update. the price doesnt matter to me, i just want to listen. if the new layout gets pushed on me i'm cancelling the day it happens.

premium went up AGAIN and the home screen still looks like TikTok with huge blocks of suggestions. im paying since 2015 and i'm about to stoop to tidal if they dont revert this garbage. absolute joke.
still worth every penny even at the new price. no ads and unlimited skips make it a no brainer for me. i wish it wasnt going up but i use it every day so i'm staying.
family plan going up a bit is still pretty cheap split between everyone in the house. honestly still worth it. just hope they dont mess with how the individual accounts work.

another price bump and i'm not thrilled. i've paid since 2018 and the features i care about are worth it to me, but they keep removing stuff without a word. i'd pay a one time price for a third party tool before i pay more to them.

still think premium is worth it, the collab playlists and connect are why i stay. but at the new price tidal gives better audio for about the same money, so it's getting harder to justify. student discount keeps me on it for now.
premium going up while the liked song hearts are still missing? not a great look. i've been subscribed for a decade but if the hearts dont come back i'm out, apple music is right there.
i'm on free so this doesnt hit me, but it's just more reason premium is out of my budget. free playlists and shuffle are enough for me for now.
fair enough, spotify is still cheaper than most and the library is hard to beat. i'm more annoyed by the repeat recommendations and the new ui hiding discover weekly than the price.

honestly the price is still absurdly low for the music. i'd pay more if artists actually got a fair cut, but right now they get almost nothing per stream and there's still no lossless tier. paying is justified, the split is the problem.

another price hike and the enhance feature still mixes recs into my own playlists. i already cancelled over feature changes so i'm close to doing it again. spotify is losing me one annoying change at a time.

price going up doesnt mean anything if the app still breaks downloads after every update. i cancelled once over a bug that went unfixed for months. i'm only still here because my library works, so just fix the app.
nickel and dime again. they raise the price and i still cant add the same song twice to a playlist. paying more for less, great. apple music is always an option.
spotify raising the price with no lossless tier is a joke. tidal already gives me hi-fi for similar money, so i keep spotify only for connect and discovery. not really a surprise.
a dollar more is still a bang for the buck for no ads, offline and skips. the free side keeps getting more ads though, which is a bigger problem than this. still worth every penny to me.
price hike? i already cancelled and the renewal popup still shows up every time i open the app. thats the thing i want fixed first. tried clearing cache and reinstalling and nothing.
subscription price going up while artists get fractions of a cent per stream. where does that money go? i already moved to apple music over artist pay and this just confirms it for me.

spotify raising prices when apple music has lossless and spatial audio for similar money is rough. spotify has to earn it with better features and cleaner ui. i'm comparing again and honestly i'm not sure it's worth it.
student plan going up a dollar is annoying, but with hulu included it's still a steal of a deal. still dumb not to use it. i'm bummed about the showtime thing too.
they shove podcasts and ai dj at me and now the price goes up too? yeah im looking at youtube music and soundcloud way more seriously now. recommendations are getting garbage.
price going up while true shuffle is still broken? get your act together spotify. i love the service overall but the shuffle problem keeps getting worse and i'd pick a true random over paying more.
